descriptionModule.briefSummary: The primary objective of this trial is to investigate the dose -response relationship of a single injection of Org 38286 to initiate multifollicular growth for the first seven days in a controlled ovarian hyperstimulation (COH) protocol for IVF or ICSI.

identificationModule.officialTitle: A Phase 2, Open Label, Randomized Trial to Investigate the Dose-Response Relationship of a Single Injection of Org 36286 (Corifollitropin Alfa) to Initiate Multiple Follicular Growth in a Controlled Ovarian Hyperstimulation Protocol for IVF or ICSI.
